notes: Intro: multi-tenant SaaS provider building hosted agents for SMB customers (chat + downstream tools).
Evaluation path: started on Hosted API -> live demo -> POC; showing interest in Dedicated if unit economics are favorable.
Primary ask: streaming stability + tool-calling reliability (external API calls from agents), 95p token-generation latency target for interactive chat.
Latency target: aiming for 95th pct < 250ms token-level for mid-size user sessions; 99th pct fallback policy acceptable if documented.
Throughput target: baseline POC sim = 3 tenants x 500 concurrent sessions -> ~60 RPS sustained; spike plan to 200 RPS burst for Black Friday scenario.
Rate-limits: per-tenant quotas required (configurable tokens/min and concurrency). Wants soft caps + hard caps and transparent 429 behaviors.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance proof, KMS integration for customer key management, audit logs retained 1 year.
Quote from VP Product: "We need predictable tail latency for interactive agents — streaming must not stall or drop tool calls."
POC scope agreed: 2-week hosted POC using streaming + tool-calling (calendar API + payments mock), success metrics: 95p token latency, no failed tool calls >0.5%.
Demo notes (2026-02-04): showed streaming API + function schema; customer liked streaming-chunk model and SDK; asked about retries for tool calls and idempotency.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market price pressure; prefers Hosted for dev but expects Dedicated pricing for production if >$15-20k/mo committed usage.
